text: ‘There is no single cause of global crime.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Global inequalities are caused by economic forces over which poorer countries have little or no
control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section B: Media
EITHER
‘The media successfully controls the way people think and behave.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘National governments are powerless to control the new media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
Section C: Religion
EITHER
‘The main role of religion is to create social solidarity.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
OR
‘Religion has just as much social significance today as in the past.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
